<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nWhen a policyholder reports the same incident through different channels, such as by phone and through the web portal, the Keelwater system creates separate claims without warning [i:037d7fd88bdfe192]. This duplicate loss report scenario leads to inaccurate reserves, complicates payments and supplier coordination, and causes confusion for adjusters because duplicates are not detected or linked at intake [i:2b2412a21ba06c15][i:72656010c210a80e]. Customers report having to manually link claims after the fact, which delays work [i:8ec45cfe56e665e5].\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Claims adjusters and operations staff** who must spend time manually cross-checking new claims, time they \"could spend on supplier coordination or reporting\" [i:82e08d8615bf7651].\n- **Finance and reporting teams** who deal with inaccurate reserves and reporting due to duplicate records [i:055ee693c115b5fa][i:603ee96296d14553].\n- **Seven customer accounts** have raised this issue through multiple routes [i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:98da20d057061932][i:dadf780eadfacb5e].\n\n## Evidence\nThe issue has been mentioned 16 times by 7 accounts across 3 routes: onboarding, sales, and support [i:037d7fd88bdfe192][i:0990586a589ee5d4][i:72656010c210a80e]. The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the accounts in the fact sheet is £5,220,000.0. Two accounts have renewals due within the next 90 days.\n- **Onboarding (3 mentions)**: During implementation, customers identified the lack of duplicate detection. One customer stated, \"the system doesn’t show any warning at intake, which leads to duplicate records and inaccurate reserves\" [i:2b2412a21ba06c15].\n- **Sales (4 mentions)**: In sales conversations, prospects describe the problem as a pain point. One noted, \"it’s messing up our reserves and supplier coordination\" [i:603ee96296d14553]. An existing customer also raised it in a sales context [i:847e58c1a543471c].\n- **Support (9 mentions)**: Live accounts have submitted support tickets describing operational impacts. One customer explained they are \"manually cross-checking every new claim to avoid the same claim twice\" [i:82e08d8615bf7651]. Another reported seeing \"disabled UI buttons that should allow linking but don’t work\" [i:e662b0d940a820b4]. Others have confirmed it creates duplicate records [i:7572aacb13bfbab0][i:dadf780eadfacb5e].\n\n## Why now\nThe problem is actively disrupting daily operations and financial reporting for multiple customers. Two customers, Tarnholt Drive Cover and Hollinbrook Home Insurance, have renewals due on 2027-01-09 and 2027-01-15, respectively [i:72656010c210a80e][i:7572aacb13bfbab0]. The volume of support tickets (9 mentions) indicates the issue is a persistent, ongoing pain [i:72656010c210a80e][i:98da20d057061932][i:dadf780eadfacb5e]. Furthermore, prospects in sales conversations are explicitly noting the problem, with one thanking a salesperson for help \"until the system catches up\" [i:4fbd615ae6ea6760].",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the claim in the \"Who is affected\" section stating that adjusters spend time they \"could spend on supplier coordination or reporting.\" The cited insight [i:82e08d8615bf7651] actually says the time is eaten up that they \"could spend on supplier coordination or reporting,\" which is a paraphrase placed inside quotation marks in the brief. I also verified the fact sheet metrics (7 accounts, 16 mentions, 3 routes, £5,220,000 ARR, 2 renewals in 90 days) and the specific renewal dates for Tarnholt Drive Cover and Hollinbrook Home Insurance, all of which match exactly. Because the quotation marks enclose a modified version of the original quote, the brief fails the faithfulness check.", "verdict": "fail"}
